name: Jorhat

queries.query: Jorhat Assam official cadastral map land records GIS parcel map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Government of Assam Directorate of Land Records, the Assam Bhu-Naksha cadastral viewer, the Government of India DILRMP Jorhat cadastral-status page, and Assam GIS/cadastral-mapping pages. The live Bhu-Naksha viewer HTML and current JavaScript were retrieved, but its anonymous proxy requests returned 401 Unauthorized and no parcel feature response was obtained.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Government of Assam Revenue & Disaster Management Directorate of Land Records and the Jorhat district administration; the DILRMP page is Jorhat-specific and reports cadastral-map digitization status for Jorhat East and Jorhat West among other revenue circles.
officialSourceAssessment.stateParcelService: Government of Assam Bhu-Naksha viewer at https://bhunaksha.assam.gov.in/.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalStatusService: Government of India Department of Land Resources DILRMP Jorhat status page at https://www.dilrmp.gov.in/dilrmpold/MapULPIN/tehsil-level/320.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: A Jorhat-specific official DILRMP cadastral-status record and a first-party Assam public cadastral viewer are evidenced. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery only; it does not qualify an adapter or prove citywide geometry availability.

schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: The current viewer JavaScript exposes proxy routes for districts, circles, villages, getAllDagsFromDharitree, getDagInfoFromDharitree, parcel_info, traceMap, and WMS/XYZ support. Direct bounded requests to the public API returned 401 Unauthorized. No safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The parcel_info route in the JavaScript references village_code, layer_code=ASSAM_PARCEL, dag_no, and crs=32646, but no response was requested without a qualified village/dag and the API remained unauthorized.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not executed against a qualified parcel endpoint; the exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
